name: Air65 Analog: VCI 0702 PRO DB 30000 KV, Gemfan 1219 3-blade 31 mm, BetaFPV LAVA 300 mAh 1S LiHV

sources.S: quadmath de9b15d script.js (calculator: motorDB, propDB, packs, models)
sources.derive: scripts/derive-air65.mjs runs quadmath's own functions (physicsFromBuild, whoopScale, whoopGroundK) on BUILD_PRESETS.air65 (B:79-86) and prints these literals

confidence: high: measured on this quad. medium: quadmath data for this build, or a quadmath class rule. low: a quadmath sim or calculator constant tuned for feel, or scaled from a class reference; no first-hand measurement exists (PROGRESS.md 2026-10-22 decisions, finding 5).

mass.source: AJ:11 auw_g 25.42, AJ:30-34 kitchen scale (dry 17.22 + pack 8.2)

wheelbase.source: AJ:5 frame_size_mm 65, used as the motor-to-motor diagonal as quadmath does (QP:8, B:198)
wheelbase.note: the bench file has no motor spacing

boxHeightRatio.source: QP:434-440 flat-box inertia, h = 0.35 x wheelbase

kv.source: AJ:8 motor_kv; motorDB S:96 'VCI 0702 PRO DB' kv 30000
kv.note: the tune card's motor is the VCI Spark 0702 29K (tune-database.js:69), a different motor (S:90-95)

vRefCell.source: B:213 batteryFromBuild full = 4.2 x cells: the pack voltage at which quadmath's thrust (tmax) holds
vRefCell.note: the bench pack is LiHV, 4.35-4.36 V full (AJ:47, AJ:56)

loadFraction.source: S:247-255 motorLoadFraction for 65 mm: the fraction of no-load rpm reached at TOP SPEED, with the props unloaded by airspeed; S:247-248 says it 'sits far above the static-hover load fraction'. quadmath uses it only in its top-speed models (S:772, S:1208)
loadFraction.note: used here as the static full-throttle point (it sets the winding resistance R and from that the rotor inertia J). No source gives a static value: no bench rpm, thrust or resistance exists, and quadmath has no static load fraction. That use is an assumption, and the source says the static value is lower (PROGRESS.md M4).

tmax.source: derive: physicsFromBuild (B:168-209) on BUILD_PRESETS.air65 (B:79-86): class reference 0.397 N (QP:19, B:14-17) scaled by (30000/23000)^0.70
tmax.note: B:83-84: 'Thrust is scaled, not a stand log'. Sets the thrust coefficient kt at full speed.

kqRatio.source: derive: physicsFromBuild kQ (B:186); QP:21, QP:305 yaw torque = kQ x thrust x wheelbase / 2
kqRatio.note: sets the prop torque coefficient kq; tuned for yaw authority in quadmath

tau.source: derive: physicsFromBuild motorTau 0.013 s (B:184) x spoolTauMul 0.73 (QP:489), quadmath's spool-up time constant
tau.note: sets rotor inertia J so the linearised motor lag at hover equals it

tauDownMult.note: parity model only; the physical motor's spool-down follows from its own equation

cdAFront.source: derive: CDA_XY0 0.0054 (QP:95) x cdMul 1.578 (QP:492 at floatiness 0.32, QP:111) x userDragMul 1.02 (H:5199, build drag 0.561 from B:185)
cdAFront.note: quadmath tuned these so a 65 mm 90-degree punch lands in 50-70 km/h (QP:93-94); prop plane = body X and Y

cdAPlan.source: derive: CDA_Z0 0.0060 (QP:96) x cdMul 1.578 x userDragMul 1.02, as cdAFront

skinB.source: owner's M4 instruction: quadratic drag, frontal and plan
skinB.note: quadmath also has a linear skin term (QP:97); not part of the M4 model

aeroB.source: owner's M4 instruction: quadratic drag, frontal and plan
aeroB.note: quadmath's rotational damping (QP:98) is not part of the M4 model

aeroC.source: owner's M4 instruction: quadratic drag, frontal and plan

discK.source: owner's M4 instruction: quadratic drag, frontal and plan
discK.note: quadmath's chopped-disc drag multiplier (QP:100) is not part of the M4 model

groundK.source: derive: whoopGroundK (W:147-151) = 0.062 x groundStr 1 (W:20) x whoopScale(build).ground (W:121), on the preset build; ground effect 1 + k (1 - h/D)^2 (QP:191-197)

capacityMah.note: the bench calibration assumes 270 mAh deliverable (AJ:47)

cellIR.source: derived from the bench discharge: (OCV at SoC 0.1 - cutoff_v_load) / average current = (3.55 - 3.28) / 4.2, with cutoff 3.28 V under load (AJ:57), 4.2 A (AJ:61), SoC 1 - 270/300 at the end (AJ:47, AJ:60), OCV 3.55 V from the OCV table (W:160-168)
cellIR.note: the bench has two points, not a curve: no rest voltage (AJ:58 null, AJ:69 pending) and no instantaneous current. Assumes the end-of-run current equals the run average. quadmath's calculator gives 46.7 mOhm (S:1175-1178 with the LAVA's listed 75C, S:496).

iRef.source: AJ:61 avg_current_a_corrected over the 233 s cruise (AJ:55); applied at the plant's own hover duty (PROGRESS.md 2026-10-22, finding 6)
iRef.note: owner decision 2026-10-22: current = bench mAh/min, throttle-proportional, until Phase 3. 4.2 A is assumed capacity over stopwatch time, +-8% (AJ:47-48).

ocv.note: a LiPo table; the bench pack is LiHV (4.35 V full, AJ:47), which no source tabulates

bounceScale.source: derive: whoopScale(build).bounce (W:115), on the preset build (25.4 g: quadmath's normalizeBuild rounds AUW to 0.1 g, B:62)

crashScale.source: derive: whoopScale(build).crashAt (W:116), on the preset build

spinScale.source: derive: whoopScale(build).spin (W:117), on the preset build
